_note: Kokoro (kokoro-js, espeak-ng en-us) pronunciation overrides for the shorts – US accent, Kokoro phoneme notation (ˈ stress, ɹ, ɚ, ɾ). Used by scripts/cine/tts.mjs; checked by scripts/video/tpl/pron.mjs audit (voice gate) and the ASR back-check in qc_v9. Add a word only with a dictionary source in 'why'. Keys = lower-case word form.

comfortable.why: espeak says /ˈkʌmftəbəl/ (no r, British); US 3-beat form KUMF-ter-ble (Merriam-Webster \ˈkəm(p)f-tər-bəl\, Cambridge US) – the pron lesson teaches 3 beats

vegetable.why: espeak says 4 beats /ˈvedʒɪɾəbəl/; US/UK 3 beats VEJ-tuh-ble (CMUdict V EH1 JH T AH0 B AH0 L, Cambridge) – the pron lesson teaches 3 beats

email.why: espeak is right (EE-mail, Cambridge/Merriam-Webster); CMUdict marks e-MAIL (IY0 M EY1 L) – listed so the audit uses the dictionary stress

marry.why: espeak says /ˈmæri/ (marry ≠ merry accent); General American merges them: /ˈmeri/ (Merriam-Webster \ˈmer-ē\, Cambridge US, CMUdict M EH1 R IY0)

married.why: past tense of marry – same General American /ˈmerid/ (Merriam-Webster, Cambridge US)

casual.why: espeak says kˈæʒuːəl (long uː); CMUdict K AE1 ZH AH0 W AH0 L = /ˈkæʒəwl/ (Merriam-Webster \\ˈka-zhə-wəl\\, Cambridge US)

opinion.why: espeak says əpˈɪniən (i-ən); CMUdict AH0 P IH1 N Y AH0 N = /əˈpɪnjən/ (Merriam-Webster \\ə-ˈpin-yən\\, Cambridge US)

conclusion.why: espeak says kəŋklˈuːʒən (ŋ, extra schwa); CMUdict K AH0 N K L UW1 ZH AH0 N = /kənˈkluːʒn/ (Merriam-Webster \\kən-ˈklü-zhən\\, Cambridge US)

ama.why: the teacher's name Ama (AH-muh, a name, not the letters A-M-A); CMUdict only has the initialism AMA = /ˌeɪeˈmeɪ/

cafe.why: espeak stresses the first syllable; CMUdict K AE0 F EY1 /kæˈfeɪ/ (Merriam-Webster \ka-ˈfā\, Cambridge US)

they're.why: espeak says ðeɪˈɚ (they-er); CMUdict THEY'RE = DH EH1 R /ðɛr/ (Merriam-Webster \ˈther\, Cambridge US)

latin.why: espeak says lˈætɪn; CMUdict L AE1 T N /ˈlætn/ (Merriam-Webster \ˈla-tᵊn\, Cambridge US)

charity.why: espeak flaps the t (tʃˈæɹᵻɾi); CMUdict CH EH1 R AH0 T IY0 /ˈtʃɛrɪti/ (Merriam-Webster \ˈcher-ə-tē\, Cambridge US)

bandwidth.why: Whisper split it as "band widths"; slower clean form B AE1 N D W IH2 D TH (CMUdict /ˈbændˌwɪdθ/, Merriam-Webster \ˈban(d)-ˌwidth\, Cambridge US)
